about.text: Yoghurt fermented by both the usual yoghurt bacteria, Streptococcus thermophilus and Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus, with a probiotic strain added besides, often a Lacticaseibacillus paracasei (formerly Lactobacillus casei) or a bifidobacterium chosen to survive in large numbers. So it is as sour as ordinary yoghurt; often sold as a small drink.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Made as yoghurt is, with both its bacteria, so it sours as much; the probiotic strain is added with them and chosen to survive in large numbers until it is eaten.
